_doc: shared = force-synced from master _shared/ — NEVER hand-edit these inside a repo; edit the master here + re-run sync. templates = copied into a repo ONLY if absent (seed-once, then project-owned). projectOwned + any other file (logs, *.json leases, progress.md, salvage/, visual/) = NEVER touched by sync. This is the single source of truth for which run-the-loop files are global vs per-project.
